The system implements a dual-layered control architecture: the first layer (GSI) governs probabilistic inference within a frozen model state, ensuring that predictions remain internally consistent and unaltered by external inputs. The second layer (GSE) manages operational behavior through state machines that enforce draft-only publishing and prevent any form of automated action. These layers interact via API endpoints that expose readiness metrics and calibration proposals, but restrict access to internal-only environments. The sandbox limitations create a failure mode where local builds cannot proceed, forcing reliance on CI pipelines which are hardened against unauthorized actions. This design reflects a deliberate separation between inference and execution domains, preventing accidental exposure of internal models or premature publication of content.
